title: Max Points on a Line
statement: Given distinct points on a plane, return the greatest number of them that lie on one straight line.
hints: Any line through two or more of these points passes through at least one of them, so you can afford to anchor on each point in turn.
Anchored at point p, two other points are on the same line through p exactly when they share a direction from p. Count directions and keep the biggest bucket.
Do not key the bucket on a double slope: dy/dx loses precision and blows up on vertical lines. Reduce (dx, dy) by their gcd and force a canonical sign, then use that pair as the key.
